# UIPageLayout

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("UIPageLayout")`

Arranges the `UIObject` children of its parent side by side as pages and shows one at a time, for a tutorial, a set of tabs or a carousel. The other pages lie beside the shown one, outside the parent's rectangle; turn `ClipsDescendants` on to hide them.

A page keeps its `Size`; its `Position` is ignored. Change page with `Next`, `Previous`, `JumpTo` and `JumpToIndex`. A swipe, the mouse wheel and a gamepad's shoulder buttons also change page unless they are turned off. `CurrentPage` changes at once, and the pages slide for `TweenTime` seconds when `Animated` is on.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Animated` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the pages slide when the page changes. When it is off, the new page appears at once. |
| `Circular` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether the pages wrap around: the page after the last is the first, and the page before the first is the last. |
| `CurrentPage` | `UIObject?` | — | read-only | The page that is shown, or the page being slid to. It is nil when there are no pages. |
| `EasingDirection` | `Enum.EasingDirection` | `Enum.EasingDirection.Out` | read/write | Which end of the slide the easing applies to. |
| `EasingStyle` | `Enum.EasingStyle` | `Enum.EasingStyle.Quad` | read/write | The easing curve of the slide. |
| `FillDirection` | `Enum.FillDirection` | `Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal` | read/write | Whether the pages are arranged, and slide, horizontally or vertically. |
| `GamepadInputEnabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether a gamepad's shoulder buttons change page. |
| `HorizontalAlignment` | `Enum.HorizontalAlignment` | `Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center` | read/write | The horizontal position of the shown page within the parent. |
| `Padding` | `UDim` | `UDim.new()` | read/write | The gap between pages. Its scale is a fraction of the parent's size along the fill direction. |
| `ScrollWheelInputEnabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the mouse wheel over the pages changes page. |
| `SortOrder` | `Enum.SortOrder` | `Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder` | read/write | The order the pages are arranged in. |
| `TouchInputEnabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether a swipe across the pages changes page, with a finger or with a mouse drag. |
| `TweenTime` | `number` | `0.3` | read/write | The duration of the slide, in seconds. |
| `VerticalAlignment` | `Enum.VerticalAlignment` | `Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center` | read/write | The vertical position of the shown page within the parent. |

## Methods

### `JumpTo(page: UIObject)`

Changes to `page`. Raises an error if the object is not one of the pages.

### `JumpToIndex(index: number)`

Changes to the page at `index`, counted from 0 in the layout's order. An index beyond either end stops at that end, or wraps around when `Circular` is on.

### `Next()`

Changes to the page after `CurrentPage`. Does nothing at the last page unless `Circular` is on.

### `Previous()`

Changes to the page before `CurrentPage`. Does nothing at the first page unless `Circular` is on.

## Events

Signals are deferred: a handler runs at the next resumption point, not
inside the call that fired the signal.

### `PageEnter(page: UIObject)`

Fires when `page` becomes `CurrentPage`, as the change to it starts.

### `PageLeave(page: UIObject)`

Fires when `page` stops being `CurrentPage`.

### `Stopped(page: UIObject)`

Fires when the slide ends with `page` shown. When `Animated` is off, it fires at once.
